candidate_responsibility: Turn validated strategy, problems, and solutions into evolvable requirements and acceptance contracts.

dimensions.question: What responsibility the source contributes to this cluster.
Methods, phases, tools, or templates contributed by the source.
Inputs consumed and artifacts or decisions produced.
Rules, gates, evidence checks, and validation criteria.
Tools, mutation authority, external effects, and consent boundaries.
Known limitations, failure modes, and unsupported assumptions.

fusion_rules.rule: Turn validated strategy, problems, and solutions into evolvable requirements and acceptance contracts.
Accept only: Problem and solution evidence, target users, strategy, metrics, risks, and delivery constraints.
Produce only: A PRD, stories, acceptance criteria, scope, open questions, dependencies, and change history.
Preserve explicit source variants and gaps; never upgrade a missing dimension or source preference into a universal rule.

input_boundary: Problem and solution evidence, target users, strategy, metrics, risks, and delivery constraints.
output_boundary: A PRD, stories, acceptance criteria, scope, open questions, dependencies, and change history.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: 把零散产品上下文转成跨职能对齐、可演进的 PRD 来源真相，而非冻结式交接合同。; 先用 solution/persona/problem/impact 形成摘要暴露歧义，正文完成后再回写。; 把可检验 epic hypothesis 连接到已拆分故事、AC、约束和边界。
source_dimension_matrix.limitations: Explicit limits: 适用于重大 initiative；不把 PRD 当成不可变 waterfall scope。; 供快速浏览，不替代正文，也不得总结未经验证的结论。; 跨职能拆到可交付粒度；示例故事数不是机械配额。
source_dimension_matrix.strengths: Provides 13 source-grounded atom(s) for responsibility (exception=1, gate=2, method=7, rule=1, template=2); each is bound to an exact source citation.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: PRD 的完整模板结构，含 10 大节与每节的必填字段; template.md 提供分节指导块、gap 标签、自我评估、能力交叉引用表
source_dimension_matrix.limitations: Explicit limits: 可裁剪但不得省略 Executive Summary/Problem Statement/User Stories&Requirements; template.md 未随 snapshot 提取，需要从上游恢复或降级为简化版输出
source_dimension_matrix.strengths: Provides 2 source-grounded atom(s) for inputs-and-outputs (template=2); each is bound to an exact source citation.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: 所有 unsupported value 首次出现即有状态，不把 placeholder/example 当事实。; hypothesis 引用 primary metric，每个 story 的 AC 自足覆盖适用边界，story 能独立交付和验收。; 每个 story 的 AC 经工程和 QA 审阅，失败模式/边界被纳入且 unresolved ambiguity 显式。
source_dimension_matrix.limitations: Explicit limits: 适用于每节；Section 10 只能汇总，不能取代 inline visibility。; 5–6 个 AC 仅是调查 story 过大的启发式；是否拆分取决于独立价值、风险和可交付性。; QA 负责独立可测试性审查，不代替 PM/设计创造业务意图；简单故事可缩短会议但不能跳过检查。
source_dimension_matrix.strengths: Provides 3 source-grounded atom(s) for gates-and-validation (gate=2, rule=1); each is bound to an exact source citation.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: 防止 PRD 规定精确视觉实现，保留设计职责。
source_dimension_matrix.limitations: Explicit limits: 高层行为和硬约束属于 PRD；像素、颜色和最终 UI 通常不属于。
source_dimension_matrix.strengths: Provides 1 source-grounded atom(s) for failure-modes (exception=1); each is bound to an exact source citation.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: 在进入 execution planning 后，用 epic breakdown advisor 按 Richard Lawrence 的 9 patterns 拆解 top epic，形成按 pattern 分类的 user stories。; 把拆解后的工作写成带 acceptance criteria 的 user stories。; 由 PM 与 engineering 基于策略和 user stories 规划 first sprint 或 release，输出 sprint backlog/release plan。
source_dimension_matrix.limitations: Explicit limits: 该步骤面向 top epic 的可交付拆分，不是对所有 backlog 做无界重构；9 patterns 是下游能力声明。; user stories 依赖已选 epic 和拆分结果；来源只声明带 acceptance criteria，不定义具体 AC 格式。; 不能把 roadmap 直接当 sprint plan；需要实际 engineering 参与和可交付范围。
source_dimension_matrix.strengths: Provides 3 source-grounded atom(s) for responsibility (method=3); each is bound to an exact source citation.
